findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.sink: parallelBinarySearch<<<blocksPerGrid, threadsPerBlock>>>(d_array, target, d_found, d_direction, array_size);
findings.trigger: If 'target' is derived from user input and the kernel execution involves executing a command on the host with this input, it could lead to command injection.
findings.assumptions: The 'target' variable is derived from user input and the kernel execution involves executing a command on the host.

findings.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
findings.trigger: If 'array_size' is very large, it could cause an integer overflow, leading to an incorrect calculation of 'blocksPerGrid'.
findings.assumptions: The 'array_size' can be influenced by user input or external factors.

findings.title: Out-of-bounds Read or Write
findings.trigger: If 'array_size' is incorrectly calculated or manipulated, it could lead to out-of-bounds memory access during the copy operations.
findings.assumptions: The 'array_size' is not properly validated or sanitized before being used in memory operations.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.trigger: If 'array_size' or 'segment_size' is manipulated or derived from user input, it could lead to incorrect memory allocation.
findings.assumptions: The 'array_size' and 'segment_size' are not properly validated or sanitized before being used in memory allocation.
